analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI exited oversold but is consolidating in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($0.14) above the 20-day low ($0.13), but the volume ratio of 0.67 indicates subdued activity, lowering confidence in a trend reversal. SMA5 ($0.15) matches the current price and is below SMA20 ($0.16), suggesting short-term weakness.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($0.21/$0.20): Below mid-to-long-term trend, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (4.7%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (26.6→36.5): Attempting to establish in neutral zone after exiting oversold, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0009→0.0013): Improving within negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $0.16): Consolidating near the middle band, band width at 33.01% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.15): Matches current price, based on Pivot S1 ($0.13).
· Swing Resistance ($0.18): Aligns with Bollinger upper band and Pivot R1 ($0.18), potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, potential for trend change but lacks volume.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.67x): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI exiting oversold and Higher Low pattern forming, but lack of volume and weak MACD improvement create uncertainty for trend reversal. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach, requiring confirmation of resistance at $0.18.
